step: Step 1 — 冻结当前串行架构证据
conclusion: 明确证明慢点来自串行 I/O 等待架构

current_architecture.scan_loop: v4_runner.py:500 — for i, fx in enumerate(fixtures): 严格串行
current_architecture.intra_fixture_fetch: serial — H2H → home recent → away recent → events → odds, all sequential
current_architecture.rpm_limiter: exists but default=450, uses list-based sliding window, not thread-safe
current_architecture.http_session_reuse: partial — urllib opener reused but no connection pooling, new TCP per request
current_architecture.team_recent_cache: in-memory dict (_RECENT_PROFILE_CACHE), no disk persistence, no TTL
current_architecture.backoff: curl fallback only, no exponential backoff

bottleneck_analysis.primary_bottleneck: serial I/O — each fixture's API calls (H2H + home recent + away recent + events) execute sequentially, and fixtures themselves iterate sequentially
bottleneck_analysis.secondary_bottleneck: no connection pooling — new TCP connection per API request
bottleneck_analysis.tertiary_bottleneck: no H2H/events cache — repeated requests for same teams/pairs across fixtures
bottleneck_analysis.serial_call_chain_per_fixture: H2H(1-5s) + home_recent(1-5s) + away_recent(1-5s) + events*N(1-5s each) = 4-20+ seconds per fixture
